title: The Vault Store draws its items in the Frequency kit instead of DAWN cards

source.ref: LIVE-938 area 4 (Vault) and the members-ui.css bridge cleanup

detail: The Frequency Vault body mounted DAWN's VaultStore widget: SectionHeader rows and StoreGrid cards with bg-primary buttons that only fit the kit because members-ui.css repainted them. FqVaultStore and FqStoreGrid draw the same categories and items with the same redeem, equip and remove server actions in the kit's g3, card, ic, t1/t2, tag and btn pieces. Gift Gems keeps its dialog; its opener is now a kit button through a triggerClassName prop. DAWN's VaultStore is unchanged for the DAWN build.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('components/frequency/members/vault/vault-body.tsx','utf8');if(s.includes(\"from '@/components/widgets/vault/vault-store'\")||!s.includes('<FqVaultStore />')){console.error('LIVE-1104: the Frequency Vault nests the DAWN Vault Store');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the Frequency Vault goes back to DAWN's VaultStore. Behavior is store-grid.test.tsx.
